headline.title: RW-Post: Auditable Evidence-Grounded Multimodal Fact-Checking in the Wild
headline.summary: RW-Post is a new benchmark designed for real-world multimodal fact-checking, addressing the challenge of visual misinformation by linking social media posts with auditable annotations and evidence. The framework utilizes LLM-assisted extraction to provide reasoning traces and relevant evidence from human fact-check articles.

articles.title: Data centers are coming for rural America
articles.summary: A former paper mill in Jay, Maine, has been repurposed into a data center following its closure in 2020 due to an explosion. The 1.4 million-square-foot facility was acquired in 2023 by JGT2 Redevelopment and partners, reflecting a growing trend of data centers moving into rural areas.

articles.title: xAI Adds 19 New Gas Turbines Despite Ongoing Lawsuit
articles.summary: xAI has announced the addition of 19 new gas turbines at its Colossus 2 site, despite an ongoing lawsuit related to air quality concerns. Internal communications reveal the company's commitment to expanding its portable gas-fired power capabilities amid the legal dispute.

articles.title: The Unitree GD01 Is a Giant Mecha Robot You Can Actually Buy
articles.summary: Unitree, known for its affordable dancing robots, has announced the sale of its new giant mecha robot, the GD01, which is capable of wall-smashing. This development marks a significant expansion in the company's product offerings within the robotics market.

articles.title: Medicare’s new payment model is built for AI, and most of the tech world has no idea
articles.summary: Medicare's new payment model, ACCESS, introduces a framework for reimbursing AI agents that monitor patients between visits and coordinate care, addressing a gap in existing healthcare payment structures. This initiative marks the first time a governmental mechanism has been established to support the integration of AI in patient management and care coordination.

articles.title: Elon Musk Had ‘Hair-Raising’ Idea of Passing OpenAI On to His Kids, Sam Altman Says
articles.summary: During a recent legal deposition, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman described Elon Musk's intense desire to maintain control over OpenAI, even suggesting the idea of passing the company on to his children. Musk's legal team interrogated Altman regarding accusations of deception and his financial ties, highlighting the ongoing tension between the two figures.

articles.title: Sam Altman was winning on the stand, but it might not be enough
articles.summary: Sam Altman testified in court after two weeks of witness accounts accusing him of dishonesty, specifically regarding allegations of stealing from a charity. His defense attorney questioned him about the accusations, highlighting the efforts made by Altman and his team in their work.

articles.title: MultiSoc-4D: A Benchmark for Diagnosing Instruction-Induced Label Collapse in Closed-Set LLM Annotation of Bengali Social Media
articles.summary: The article introduces MultiSoc-4D, a benchmark dataset for analyzing the performance of Large Language Models (LLMs) in annotating Bengali social media comments. The dataset includes over 58,000 comments annotated for category, sentiment, hate speech, and sarcasm, addressing the challenges of instruction-induced label collapse in low-resource languages.

articles.title: Two Hebrew folk meteorological proverbs tested: rainfall on Rosh Chodesh and Shabbat Mevarechim as predictors of monthly precipitation (Israel, 1950-2024)
articles.summary: A study tested two Hebrew folk meteorological proverbs regarding their predictive accuracy for monthly rainfall in Israel from 1950 to 2024. The findings indicate that the proverbs, which associate rainy days on specific lunar calendar dates with overall monthly precipitation, show varying degrees of correlation with actual rainfall patterns.

articles.title: RETUYT-INCO at BEA 2026 Shared Task 2: Meta-prompting in Rubric-based Scoring for German
articles.summary: The paper details the RETUYT-INCO team's participation in the BEA 2026 shared task focused on rubric-based short answer scoring for German, specifically in three tracks involving unseen answers and questions. The team developed a method called Meta-prompting to adapt to the evolving requirements of the scoring tasks.

articles.title: Quantifying Rodda and Graham Gait Classification from 3D Makerless Kinematics derived from a Single-view Video in a Heterogeneous Pediatric Clinical Cohort
articles.summary: A recent study presents a method for quantifying the Rodda and Graham gait classification using 3D makerless kinematics derived from single-view video analysis in a diverse pediatric cohort with cerebral palsy. This approach aims to enhance gait assessment accuracy, which is crucial for maintaining walking function in children with this condition.

articles.title: SpatialForge: Bootstrapping 3D-Aware Spatial Reasoning from Open-World 2D Images
articles.summary: SpatialForge is a new approach that enhances spatial reasoning capabilities in Large Vision-Language Models (VLMs) by leveraging open-world 2D images for training. This method aims to improve performance on geometric tasks such as depth ordering and coordinate grounding, addressing limitations posed by traditional scene-centric datasets.
